links.comparator_used: Original medical notes written in clinical language (within-subjects, each participant viewed two original and two GPT-4 lay-language notes)
links.outcome: Objective comprehension, subjective understanding, perceived empathy, mental effort and negative emotions when reading medical notes
links.effect: Higher comprehension scores (effect size details not reported in abstract), greater subjective understanding, higher perceived empathy, reduced mental effort and negative emotions; significant improvements across all measured dimensions except average reading times
links.tradeoff: No significant difference in average reading times; accuracy validation and clinician workflow integration still need investigation
links.quote: LLM translation of medical notes significantly improved both objective and subjective patient understanding.

design_hint: LLM translation of medical notes into lay language (reading-level simplification)
